title: Jethro Tull's seed drill
place: Howberry, near Crowmarsh Gifford, Oxfordshire, England
summary: Jethro Tull developed a horse-drawn seed drill that planted seeds in neat rows at the right depth.
why: Part of the British Agricultural Revolution.

notes.problem: Wrong place: source puts his farm at Howberry near Crowmarsh Gifford, Oxfordshire; Berkshire is only his probable birthplace.
